purpose: Make growth, original IP, commercialization and production one evidence-coupled media business system rather than four adjacent silos.

loops.rule: Views alone never determine portfolio allocation; retention, follow/save/share, audience quality, strategic fit, repeatability and commercial adjacency are considered separately.
IP assets serve recognition, storytelling and reusable rights value; the character is not forced into every shot or topic.
Measure whether distinctive assets improve recognition/qualified growth; aesthetic preference alone is insufficient.
Commercial fit is planned early but cannot rewrite factual/editorial conclusions.
Brand requirements alter deliverables, rights and evidence needs; product truth remains hard-gated.
Shots bind exact canon versions; prompt memory never substitutes for asset identity.
Production economics change format and investment, not editorial truth.
One successful/failed post creates evidence, not automatic canon mutation.
Commercial learning is outcome-accountable; impressions/views alone do not establish sponsor effectiveness.
Durable changes require scoped evidence, counterexamples and regression/replay; provider observations remain volatile.

invariants: Editorial/product truth and audience trust outrank sponsor convenience.
No workstream owns a private duplicate of an asset/decision that another workstream consumes; consumers reference the authoritative object/version.
Cross-workstream influence is explicit evidence/decision flow, never hidden prompt context.
No single metric, including views, CTR, completion or revenue, is the global objective.
IP is measured as a reusable audience/business asset, not only as character aesthetics.
Commercialization begins before production when it affects deliverables/rights/truth assets, but sponsorship is not required for content worthiness.
Production decisions emit cost/retry/reuse evidence back to portfolio planning.
Platform derivatives preserve source lineage and are re-authored for platform behavior rather than blindly clipped.
